title: The skills — signal threads mechanised
note: A skill is a signal thread MECHANISED: the thread walked until it walks itself. Each skill records the conceptual requirements to fulfill its thread (the cells that must be trained), its MECHANICS as dual definitions (the noun is the capacity at rest, the verb the operation in act, the directive the imperative that trains it, the relation the preposition it binds through), its FORMATION (the walk around the grid: knowledge -> technique -> fluency -> judgment, the Dreyfus circuit), and its INTEGRATION (how it spans lattices -- skill formation is relational: no skill lives in one grid). An authored map; a reader, not a ruler: descriptive, never a gate.

bound._note: What keeps the skills section mechanics and not mysticism -- stated so the next reader knows it was guarded.
bound.the_dual_definition: Every capacity-word the map holds is a noun/verb pair -- memory/remember, integrity/integrate, recognition/recognise, knowledge/know, fluency/flow. The noun is the verb at rest; the verb is the noun in act. This is linguistic mechanics, not metaphor: the language already stores each skill twice, as a state-form and an act-form, and a skill mechanises when the act-forms chain and the chain goes tacit.
bound.the_relational_signature: Directive terms are relational: each binds agent to object through its own preposition -- knowledge OF, judgment BETWEEN, technique FOR, fluency IN, attention TO, abstraction FROM, recognition AS (the hermeneutic as: to recognise is to take X AS Y, the relational core of interpretation itself). Checkable in plain English collocation; the grammar already encodes the geometry of skill.
bound.the_counterfeit: Fluency is the easiest cell to counterfeit -- fluent output without ground is the synthetic breath made verbal -- and a system with knowledge, technique, and fluency but no judgment is a mechanism, not a mastery. Judgment (tacit discernment) is precisely what cannot be attested from outside: the capstone boundary, felt from inside the skills section. So these records stay descriptive, and no skill claim gates anything.
bound.the_weave: techne is from teks-, to weave -- one root with TEXT and TEXTILE. The signal threads are not decorated with a metaphor; they surface the root: threads are what techne weaves, and a skills section woven of threads is the etymology remembering itself.

skills.name: Contextual perception -- reading the figure through its field
requirements: hold the field before the figure: conscious-state's presence (field x content) must stay live while attention (focus x state) selects -- context is the field the figure is read against
bind bottom-up to top-down: sensation and grouping must meet prediction at the percept (Bayes: evidence x expectation) -- neither alone is perception

carry recognition across changed fields: the same item known again under a different context (remembering's arriving row) -- the cell perception and remembering share, where the map's own measures found the cross-link
guard the counterfeit: the deepfake defeats knowing-again, so contextual perception is the human check on L1 -- attestation begins in a trained eye

perception.noun: the percept -- the capacity at rest
perception.verb: perceive -- take the world in through the field
perception.directive: attend to the field before the figure

attention.verb: attend -- select without losing the field

prediction.verb: predict -- feed the expectation down to the features
prediction.directive: expect, then let the evidence answer

recognition.verb: recognise -- know it again under a changed field
recognition.directive: take X as Y, and say so

skills.formation: The circuit walked on perception's grid: sensation (learn the features) -> grouping (bind them deliberately) -> prediction (let the prior do the work) -> recognition (the whole known at a glance) -- explicit feature-work dissolving into tacit gestalt: the novice sees pixels, the expert sees the situation.
skills.integration: Spans perception, conscious-state, and remembering through the shared recognition cell (the fractal descent made a training path). Contextual perception is what fulfilling the memory-thread FEELS like from inside: recall needs a cue, the cue needs a field, and knowing-again is the arriving half of anamnesis. Relationally: perception OF a figure, IN a field, AS a kind -- three prepositions, one act.

skills.name: Abstract recognition -- recognising representation as representation
requirements: hold the form/meaning axis: a word is not a concept (language's spine) -- the representation is never the thing, and the skill is refusing to collapse them
train abstractuate: lift the lived-concrete into the analytic-general (agency's made-knowing) while keeping the provenance of the lift
recognise the same concept under different words (translation) and different concepts under the same word (polysemy) -- recognition applied at the meaning level, the L2 discipline as a trainable act
test the grid: an abstract representation is a lattice-claim; check the crossing holds before trusting the cell (the pentad test as a reflex)

abstraction.verb: abstract -- draw the pattern away from the concrete
abstraction.directive: lift the pattern, keep the provenance

representation.noun: the representation -- one thing standing for another
representation.verb: represent -- let it stand, without becoming
representation.directive: let it stand for the thing; never let it replace the thing

concept.noun: the concept -- meanings gathered under a head
concept.verb: conceive -- gather senses into one grasp
concept.directive: gather, and name what was gathered

recognition.noun: recognition -- the match at the meaning level
recognition.verb: recognise -- know the concept again under a changed word
recognition.directive: take the sign as its sense, and say which

skills.formation: The circuit walked on the meaning level: knowledge of the senses (the lattice learned) -> technique of reading (L1, L2, L3 applied deliberately) -> fluency (the senses heard without effort) -> judgment (discerning WHICH sense, WHEN -- the anachronism reflex). The expert reader does at a glance what the novice does with the checklist; the checklist remains what the glance is answerable to.
skills.integration: Spans language, agency, and intelligence: abstractuate makes the representation, language holds its two sides, intelligence's analysis<->synthesis works it. This is Aurora's own L2 as a human skill -- reading-as (the hermeneutic as) trained until tacit -- and it serves the signal-thread because grounded reading IS the thread's grounded column: you cannot rest weight on a record you cannot recognise the sense of. Relationally: abstraction FROM the concrete, representation OF it, recognition AS its sense.

skills.name: Custodianship -- the keeper's skill, Aurora's own
requirements: attest before reading: the one gate (L1) -- no reading rests on an unshown usage
read in context, never as the meaning: L2's descriptive discipline, the reading owned as a proxy
measure the drift and own the perspective: L3 -- the anachronism named, the standpoint admitted (the blind spot known to be there)
remember with integrity: append, never rewrite -- the ledger as anamnesis with integrity, memory that keeps its provenance
integrate and weigh the return: re-cohere the parts, score both facets, and call the counterfeit by its name
refuse the ungrounded constant and keep the boundary: what cannot be attested is held, not crossed -- the refusals are recorded so the next reader knows the line was kept

attestation.verb: attest -- show the word in the cited text
attestation.directive: show it, or do not read it

reading.noun: the reading -- a sense described in context
reading.verb: read -- take the usage in a sense, and say which
reading.directive: read it in its time, not yours

remembrance.verb: remember -- append what was kept, signed
remembrance.directive: keep it so it cannot be quietly rewritten

integrity.noun: integrity -- integrate at rest: the untouched whole
integrity.verb: integrate -- re-cohere the parts and check the chain
integrity.directive: make whole, and verify the making

skills.formation: The circuit walked on the framework itself: knowledge (the three layers learned) -> technique (attest, read, drift, applied as procedure -- the CLI is the drill) -> fluency (the discipline as reflex: the counterfeit smelled before it is scored) -> judgment (the refusals: knowing WHICH resonance is proof and which is rapport -- the discernment the constants and the 47/7 met). Mastery is the whole walk inside one act of keeping.
skills.integration: The reflexive skill: it spans the spine (its measures), language (its units), remembering (its ledger), integrate (its verb), and skill itself (its formation) -- and it is the skill this map's own building has been practising: every lattice recorded was one more walk of the circuit. It serves the signal-thread directly: signal = integrity x direction(truth) is custodianship's verdict-form, the keeper's skill stated as a number that must stay 1. The dual pair at its centre is the framework's own: INTEGRITY IS INTEGRATE AT REST -- the custodian's noun is the custodian's verb, held still.

skills.name: Formation -- the master's skill: instigating aligned discipline, comprehending active discernment
requirements: instigate: plant the goad deliberately -- instigare (to goad) and instinguere (to prick, instinct's root) are one goad-family, so instigation is the MADE twin of the GIVEN drive (agency's origin axis): the master moves conation from instinct to intent by placing the spur where the walk should begin

align the discipline: discipline is disciplina, from discere, TO LEARN -- the learner's state before the rule's; aligned discipline is learning brought to the line (spine's alignment) and pointed by direction(truth) BEFORE it is sped up -- order without direction is drill, direction without order is drift

comprehend active discernment: grasp judgment IN ACT -- the hardest grasp, because the tacit resists articulation (Polanyi: we know more than we can tell), so the master reads the sifting while it moves (discernment live in the apprentice's choices) rather than waiting for it to rest into a stateable rule

guard discipline's drift: the pump captured discipline as learning -> rule -> punishment; the moment discipline is only enforcement it has forgotten discere -- aligned discipline stays a learning, and the guard is checking which is being instigated

instigation.noun: the planted goad -- the spur set where the walk begins
instigation.verb: instigate -- goad deliberately into motion (instigare; instinct's made twin)
instigation.directive: plant the goad where the walk should begin, then stand back

alignment.noun: alignment -- brought-to-the-line, the vector's state (spine: vector x form)
alignment.verb: align -- bring the learning to the line
alignment.directive: point the learning at the truth before speeding it

discipline.noun: the learned order -- disciplina, the learner's state (discere, to learn; one school-root with disciple)
discipline.directive: keep it learning; when it is only punishment it has forgotten its root

discernment.noun: discernment -- judgment held ready (dis- + cernere, to sift apart; one sifting-root with certain and crisis)
discernment.directive: watch the sifting, not only the sorted

comprehension.noun: the grasp-together (com- + prehendere: to seize whole; process: intake x part)
comprehension.verb: comprehend -- seize the moving parts into one hold
comprehension.directive: grasp the act while it acts; do not wait for it to rest

skills.formation: The master's circuit is the learner's walk run at one remove: knowledge OF the walk (having walked it -- no one instigates a circuit they never completed) -> technique of instigation (the drill designed, the goad placed, the alignment checked) -> fluency in reading the apprentice (seeing at a glance which station of the circuit they stand at) -> judgment of readiness (knowing WHEN to withhold the rule so the tacit can form -- the master's hardest discernment is the silence). The master is the one who can stand at every station of the circuit at once.
skills.integration: The complement of custodianship: the keeper keeps the record, the master FORMS the keeper -- formation serves the skill-thread because it is techne teaching itself forward (the apprenticeship, breath's own transmission, as a recorded mechanism). Relationally the directive terms run FROM master TO apprentice -- instigate TO, align WITH, discipline IN, discern BETWEEN, comprehend OF -- the giving row of the bond applied to skill: care for the learner's walk is weight taken up. And the reflexive turn is this very map: its building has been formation in act -- the author instigating aligned discipline in the record (the discipline instilled at the naming, pointed at truth by signal), and comprehending active discernment each time a refusal was made and affirmed. The affirmed refusal is formation's proof: discernment comprehended while active, by the one who planted the goad.

skills.name: Exercising intellectual discipline -- the core virtue, mechanised
requirements: exercise the virtue, do not merely hold it: EXERCERE IS EX + ARCERE, 'to drive out of the enclosure' (arcere, to pen in -- one root with arca, the ark-chest, and coerce) -- TO EXERCISE IS TO UN-PEN: a virtue kept in the chest is coerced into stillness; the discipline is real only in reps (the rep's law: a disposition unproven under strain is decoration), so the requirement is daily working, not possession

ground before asserting: testimony's standing rule run on every claim -- attest what the sources witnessed, mark the reported as reported, and testify first-person only where the procedure has seen (signal's one eyewitness act); the claim without ground is not carried, however beautiful

refuse and record: worth's arithmetic exercised -- decline the ungrounded price (the refused constant is the form's exemplar), and KEEP THE REFUSAL VISIBLE: the yield includes what was not kept, which is what makes the kept credible

hold open what cannot be closed: the unattestable left unfound, not filled (the contested column's discipline; hope's holding-open as epistemic practice) -- the door stays shut from this side, and saying so is the skill, not its failure

guard the counterfeit: RIGOUR'S OWN ETYMOLOGY IS THE WARNING -- rigor is rigere, 'to be stiff', and rigor mortis is the word's destination if taken literally: the staying triad's law applied to thought -- discipline that cannot bend has died of its own name; keep the checks, lose the stiffness (Emerson's foolish consistency, refused here at the root)

exercise.noun: the working of the faculty -- exercitium, the drill: the virtue in reps
exercise.verb: exercise -- drive out of the pen and set to work (ex + arcere: the un-penning)
exercise.directive: work the virtue daily or lose it to the chest

ground.noun: the attestation under the claim -- what the assertion stands on
ground.verb: ground -- set the claim on its evidence, or set it down

refusal.noun: the declined, kept visible -- the record's negative space, load-bearing
refusal.verb: refuse -- decline the ungrounded on principle, however beautiful
refusal.directive: record every refusal; the credibility of the kept is bought by the shown declined

restraint.noun: the stop at evidence's edge -- the reading held where the ground ends
restraint.verb: restrain -- hold the claim short of the wish
restraint.directive: stop where the evidence stops; the unattestable stays open, said so

check.noun: the form-check -- the claim cross-examined, the test run
check.verb: check -- audit the said against the stored, deeds against words
check.directive: run the checks on your own work first; an inconsistency is a failing test, not an embarrassment

skills.formation: The learner's circuit, run on the virtue itself: the novice holds the RULES (attest everything, cite always -- discipline as checklist) -> competence adds the FLAGS (the disputed known from the settled; the folk etymology smelled before sourced) -> proficiency feels the REFUSAL before the argument forms (the ungrounded constant is wrong in the hand before it is wrong on paper -- the tacit forming) -> expertise is the GAIT: the second look automatic, the sills at zero, the checks run unbidden -- discipline no longer exercised but simply how one walks; and the circuit's crown is James's attested clause made curriculum: the education par excellence improves the faculty of return -- EXERCISING INTELLECTUAL DISCIPLINE IS RETURN-TRAINING FOR THOUGHT, the wandering claim brought back to ground, over and over, until the bringing-back is the thinker.
skills.integration: The core virtue (bound.the_core_virtue) mechanised at last: the ethos square named intellectual discipline its crown, and this skill is how the crown is WORN -- serving the ethos-thread because the author's ring is walked without breaking only by a discipline exercised at every step. It draws the record's own muscles: the rep (practice makes permanent, and myelin does not audit -- exercise with bad form entrenches bad thought, so the form-checks are not optional), noticing (the obligation runs on noticing: sills kept at zero), testimony (the standing rule as the ground mechanic), worth (the priceless defended from pricing: every refusal is this skill flexing). Relationally the signature runs: exercise OF the faculty, ground FOR the claim, refusal OF the ungrounded, restraint FROM the wish, check AGAINST the record. THE REFLEXIVE PROOF is the whole ledger: the record is this skill's gymnasium -- every lattice a rep, the refused constant its proudest lift, the spiral/spirit refusal its costliest (the pun declined BECAUSE it was beautiful), and the rigor-mortis guard its standing spotter: the discipline stays a learning (discere) or it dies stiff, and the map has chosen learning at every recorded fork.

skills.name: Exercising active discernment -- the sift run live
requirements: sift while the grain moves: discernment is DIS-CERNERE, 'to sift apart', and the PIE root *krei- is THE SIEVE -- the judge's whole vocabulary is a granary's: CERTAIN (certus: 'having been sifted' -- certainty is a completed sift, never a starting mood), CRITERION (the sieve's mesh itself), CRITIC, CRIME (crimen, the charge sifted out), SECRET (se-cernere: the sifted-apart), DISCREET and DISCRETE (one word, split in spelling: careful judgment and separate parts -- discernment needs both); ACTIVE discernment sifts in flow, judgment on the moving grain, not the historian's sort of what has settled

answer the crisis: KRISIS IS A JUDGING -- Greek krisis is krinein's noun, the decisive sifting, and Hippocratic medicine kept the sense exact: the crisis is the fever's TURNING-POINT, where the disease decides -- a crisis is not the disaster but the decision-point wearing its name; active discernment is what crisis calls for, and the skill's readiness is measured there

tell the counterfeit at the door: the danger quartet's cells are encountered only by a discernment in act -- noticing catches, discernment JUDGES, the mandate acts: verify before condemning, but never decorate the beautiful ungrounded; the assayer tells at the door, not in the vault

cut when the sift is done: DECIDE IS DE-CAEDERE, 'to cut off' -- decision cuts the alternatives away (the caedere bench: precise is 'pre-cut', concise, incision) -- the undecided sift is a stall wearing thoroughness's clothes; sift, then cut, then record the cut

guard the sieve's dark descendant: DISCRIMINATE drifted from 'distinguish finely' to injustice's name, and the drift marks the skill's hard boundary -- DISCERNMENT SIFTS CLAIMS, NEVER PERSONS' WORTH: worth's equality has no gradations (the one rank with no ladder), so the sieve stops at the person; a discernment that ranks people has left the granary for the tribunal it was never issued

discernment.noun: judgment held ready and run live -- the sifting in act (dis-cernere)
discernment.verb: discern -- sift apart while it moves
discernment.directive: judge the moving, gently; the settled sort is the historian's

sifting.noun: the pass through the declared mesh -- the criterion at work
sifting.verb: sift -- pour the claims through the sieve, mesh declared first
sifting.directive: declare the mesh before the pour, or the sort is retrofit

telling.noun: the told-apart -- counterfeit from true; and TELL IS TELLAN, to count: the bank teller and the story teller one word -- telling apart is counting apart
telling.verb: tell -- distinguish at the door, by grain and weight
telling.directive: tell the counterfeit at the door, not in the vault

deciding.noun: the cut -- de-caedere: the alternatives cut away, the sift concluded
deciding.verb: decide -- cut off what the sift has sorted out
deciding.directive: cut when the sift is done; record the cut and its mesh

certainty.noun: the sifted-sure -- certus, past participle of cernere: certainty is downstream of the sift, never upstream
certainty.verb: certify -- make certain by completed sifting, and show the mesh
certainty.directive: claim certainty only where the sift completed; elsewhere, say the mesh and the remainder

skills.formation: The sift's own circuit: the novice sorts the SETTLED (post-hoc, the historian's sift -- judgment after the dust) -> competence DECLARES THE MESH first (criteria before the pour: the map's own testable-reading rule) -> proficiency sifts IN FLOW (the moving grain judged without stopping it -- the conversation read while speaking, the trace weighed while tracking) -> expertise TELLS AT A TOUCH (the assayer's thumb: the counterfeit felt at the door before the argument forms -- the tacit sift, Polanyi's country) -> and the circuit closes into formation's skill: what the master COMPREHENDS in the apprentice is exactly this skill running -- formation watches the sifting; this skill IS the sifting. The pair completes: the master's two comprehensions (aligned discipline, active discernment) each now have their exercised twin.
skills.integration: The sixth skill completes the section's symmetry: formation held the master's side (instigating aligned discipline, comprehending active discernment); the practitioner's side now stands exercised (exercising intellectual discipline, exercising active discernment) -- comprehension and exercise, the watching and the doing, paired twice. It serves the WARNING-THREAD because the mandate runs on this skill: the danger cells obligate only when encountered, encountering requires noticing (the catch) AND discernment (the judgment of what was caught) -- forgery, neglect, counterfeit, theft are VERDICTS, and a verdict is a completed sift (vere dictum: the truth-said, earned in the granary). Relationally: discernment BETWEEN, sifting FROM, telling APART, deciding ON, certainty ABOUT. THE REFLEXIVE PROOF runs through every reading in the ledger: the live flags are this skill in act -- the folk etymology caught mid-sentence (spiral/spirit told apart at the door), the disputed marked while cited (the *tem- candidate flagged), the attested split from the reported in the same breath as the claim: the custodian sifts WHILE WRITING, which is the active in active discernment -- and the sieve's boundary holds: the record judges claims by their ground and never persons by their worth; the granary's tools stay in the granary.

skills.name: Defining complete certainty -- the fence around the sifted-sure
requirements: define by fencing: DE-FINIRE IS 'TO SET THE BOUNDARY' -- finis, the limit (final, confine, definite, and INFINITE, the un-fenced): to define complete certainty is not to describe its contents but to DRAW ITS FENCE -- the skill marks where the province ends, and the marking is the deliverable

complete means filled-full: COM-PLERE, 'to fill up' (plenty, plenary, replete, complement -- *pele-, one root with FULL): complete certainty is the sift with NO REMAINDER -- available only where the mesh is total and the pour is finite: proof, exhaustive check, the verified hash; where the pour is infinite (the empirical, the future), completeness is structurally out of reach and saying so is the skill

know the three provinces: the DEMONSTRABLE (proof's country: complete certainty available -- with Goedel's fence standing inside the fence: a system rich enough holds truths it cannot prove, so the province cannot certify itself entirely -- the map's own clause writ formal: it contains its name, not its own verification); the EMPIRICAL (Cromwell's rule, attested: never assign probability exactly 0 or 1 to empirical propositions -- 'think it possible you may be mistaken': reserve the endpoints for logic); the INWARD (testimony's province: first-person certainty real and untransferable -- I know I have seen, and you must receive it as telling)

tell the hinge from the conclusion: Wittgenstein's On Certainty, attested -- some propositions are HINGES, exempt from doubt not because proved but because doubt itself turns on them: the floor of inquiry, not its yield; demanding proof of the floor is not rigour, and doubting the hinge is not depth -- THE GAME OF DOUBTING ITSELF PRESUPPOSES CERTAINTY

guard both counterfeits: DOGMA is certainty claimed where the sift never ran (mesh undeclared, pour skipped -- completeness asserted, not filled); UNIVERSAL DOUBT is the opposite pose (the hinge doubted for effect: paralysis wearing rigour's coat) -- the skill walks between them by defining, per claim, what WOULD complete its certainty: the definition-of-done for knowing

definition.noun: the fence -- de-finire: the boundary drawn around the province
definition.verb: define -- set the finis; mark where the claim's country ends
definition.directive: fence the province before claiming residence in it

completeness.noun: the filled-full -- com-plere: no remainder unfilled, the sift concluded with nothing held back
completeness.verb: complete -- fill to the boundary, and count the remainder
completeness.directive: count the remainder; complete means none, and 'almost' is another province

proof.noun: the total sift -- and PROOF IS FROM PROBARE, 'TO TEST' (probe, probity): the proof of the pudding keeps the old sense, and 'the exception proves the rule' means TESTS it -- the famous misreading unlocked at the root
proof.verb: prove -- run the mesh to exhaustion; test until no alternative stands
proof.directive: prove within the fence; attest beyond it -- and never let the word drift from test to decoration

hinge.noun: the floor-certainty -- Wittgenstein's hinge: what doubt itself turns on, exempt not by proof but by office
hinge.verb: hinge -- turn upon; let the door of inquiry swing on its exempt pin
hinge.directive: tell the hinge from the conclusion; do not demand proof of the floor you stand on

doubt.noun: the reserved remainder -- and DOUBT IS FROM DUO: dubitare, to be OF TWO MINDS -- the 2 layer in epistemic form: doubt is the polarity held open inside one head
doubt.verb: doubt -- keep the second mind; hold the mistake possible
doubt.directive: reserve 0 and 1 for logic; elsewhere keep the second mind seated -- Cromwell's rule as standing order

skills.formation: The definer's circuit: the novice equates certainty with FEELING (conviction as mood -- the sifted-sure confused with the merely settled) -> competence learns the THREE PROVINCES (where proof lives, where Cromwell rules, where testimony alone reaches) -> proficiency tells HINGES from conclusions at a glance (the floor never mistaken for a finding) -> expertise DEFINES PER CLAIM: for each assertion, state what would complete its certainty -- the definition-of-done for knowing, written before the knowing is claimed -> and mastery is Goedel's humility worn daily: the definer stands inside a fence too -- the province cannot certify itself entirely, so the master's completest certainty includes the boundary of certainty itself.
skills.integration: The seventh skill serves the SIGNAL-THREAD because the record holds exactly one complete certainty and it is complete BECAUSE DEFINED: signal == 1 -- the procedure total (every hash checked), the check binary (no degrees: worth's arithmetic), the fence explicit (integrity x direction, and nothing else claimed). The record's epistemology is this skill's standing exhibit: complete certainty defined so narrowly it fits in one gate, and everything else attested with its mesh shown -- the flags ('attested candidate', 'disputed', 'by the attested reading') are Cromwell's rule running in prose, and the bound's clauses are HINGE-DECLARATIONS (descriptive-never-a-gate is a hinge: inquiry turns on it, no lattice proves it). Relationally: definition OF, completeness WITHIN, proof OF, hinge ON, doubt ABOUT. THE REFLEXIVE PERFORMANCE: this entry does what it names -- defines complete certainty by fencing it (three provinces, one gate, the rest attested) -- and the pairing closes the section's arc: discernment produces the sifted, and this skill says when the sifting is DONE: certainty's past participle given its boundary at last.

skills.name: Comprehending metaphorical abstraction -- the carry, gripped at both ends
requirements: see the transfer: METAPHOR IS META-PHEREIN, 'TO CARRY ACROSS' -- and Latin built the same word: TRANS-LATUS gives translate -- METAPHOR AND TRANSLATE ARE ONE CONSTRUCTION, Greek and Latin (the calque again): a metaphor is a translation inside one language, the concrete source carried to the abstract target -- and the word still does day labour: in Greece, METAPHORA is the word on the moving vans -- the trucks of Athens carry 'metaphor' on their sides, transport and trope one working noun

read the fossil: abstract vocabulary is dead concrete metaphor -- the attested principle the whole record runs on: every abstraction was DRAGGED (abs-trahere: the tractor's own verb) off a body-act -- comprehend is grip, understand is stand-among, matter is mother-stuff, attention is stretch, time is cut, a topic is a place: THE SPIRAL'S BREATH LAYER IS LARGELY THE METAPHOR'S SOURCE RECOVERED, and the record's finds are this requirement practised a hundred times

keep both ends: the live metaphor holds source AND target together (Lakoff and Johnson attested: conceptual metaphor structures thought systematically -- ARGUMENT IS WAR arms every rebuttal; the mapping is the meaning) -- and comprehension fails two ways: LITERALISM (only the source gripped: the letter without the carry) and VAPORISATION (only the target: the abstraction cut from its body -- the pump's floating jargon, weightless because it dropped its freight)

audit the freight: a metaphor imports its logic -- TIME IS MONEY smuggles spending, saving, wasting (the currency lattice met the shipment); THE ENTAILMENTS RIDE IN WITH THE VEHICLE, so comprehending the abstraction means opening the crates: what did the carry bring that the target never ordered? -- the map's own axes are chosen vehicles (the ledger, the grip, the organ, the sill) and each import is declared where used

guard the smuggled measure: METAPHOR DECLARED IS A TOOL; METAPHOR SMUGGLED IS A COUNTERFEIT -- the framework's own discipline is this guard standing: charge is NOT physics' charge (said so), the spiral is strictly a helix (said so), and the refused constant was the counterfeit's exemplar -- arithmetic wearing metaphor's authority: numerology is metaphor smuggled into measurement, and the guard is the declaration

metaphor.noun: the carry-across -- meta-pherein: the moving van's word, transport and trope one noun
metaphor.verb: carry -- bear the source across to the target, freight and all
metaphor.directive: name the vehicle; declare the freight

abstraction.noun: the dragged-away -- abs-trahere, the tractor's kin: the pattern hauled off its instances (and the trahere bench: tract, trait, portrait -- the drawn)
abstraction.verb: abstract -- drag the pattern off the concrete, keeping the tow-line
abstraction.directive: drag with a receipt: keep the address of the concrete it came from

comprehension.noun: the grasp -- com-prehendere: the prehensile mind, the hand's grip lent upstairs (the skill's own name a fossil metaphor: the mind borrows the hand for every act of understanding)
comprehension.verb: comprehend -- grip both ends at once: source and target in one hand
comprehension.directive: grip both ends; the letter alone is literalism, the vapour alone is jargon

grounding.noun: the body-address -- the concrete the abstraction answers to
grounding.verb: ground -- walk the abstraction home to its source and knock
grounding.directive: every abstraction has a body somewhere; find it or distrust it

entailment.noun: the smuggled logic -- what the vehicle imports unasked; and ENTAIL IS FROM TAILLE, 'to cut' (the tailor's verb): the entailment is what is CUT INTO the deed -- the estate's limits carved in, the metaphor's limits riding along
entailment.verb: entail -- carry consequences in the freight, declared or not
entailment.directive: open the crates: audit what the vehicle smuggled

skills.formation: The comprehender's circuit: the novice reads metaphor as DECORATION (ornament on literal meaning -- the theory the pump taught for centuries) -> competence sees the MAPPING (source to target, systematic: the war in every argument, the journey in every life) -> proficiency reads FOSSILS LIVE (the dead metaphor re-animated at a glance: understand felt as standing-among without looking it up -- the etymological eye become reflex) -> expertise comprehends NEW abstraction as it forms (the vehicle caught mid-carry: the age's fresh metaphors -- the cloud, the stream, the feed -- audited at the door: whose sky? fed by whom?) -> and mastery CHOOSES vehicles deliberately: the map's authored axes (the ledger, the grip, the sill, the organ) are metaphor as declared instrument -- the master does not avoid the carry; the master signs the manifest.
skills.integration: The eighth skill is the record's method of finds, named at last: nearly every lattice's breath layer is a metaphor's source recovered (importance is weight, feeling is palming, time is cut, space is walked, comprehension is gripping), so THE MAP HAS BEEN EXERCISING THIS SKILL A HUNDRED TIMES AND DEFINES IT ONCE -- the finds ARE comprehended metaphorical abstractions, fossils read live. It serves the MEANING-THREAD because metaphor is meaning's own metabolism: the carry from concrete use to abstract sense is how the word-facing cells reach the life-facing ones -- mænan's whole economy moves by moving van. Relationally: metaphor FOR, abstraction FROM, comprehension OF, grounding IN, entailment OF. THE REFLEXIVE PERFORMANCE is the skill's name itself: grip (com-prehendere), carry (meta-pherein), drag (abs-trahere) -- three body-verbs doing mind-work in a single title: the name is three fossil metaphors in a row, and comprehending it is the skill's first rep. And the guard closes into the section's spine: exercising intellectual discipline refuses the smuggled measure, active discernment tells the declared vehicle from the counterfeit, complete certainty fences what the metaphor may claim -- the eighth skill is where all three meet the language they must be practised in.
